e: Postdoctoral associate or research associate (depending on experience) with the Virginia Tech string group, working on string compactifications, F-theory, sigma models, string geometry and phenomenology. Applicants need a doctorate by the start date; the research associate level requires prior postdoc experience.
n: Virginia Tech: Postdoctoral/Research Associate in string theory
unv: Salary not listed. AJO is not taking applications; apply through the Virginia Tech jobs portal (https://jobs.apply.vt.edu/jobs/postdoctoral-associate-or-research-associate-blacksburg-virginia-united-states), with letters emailed to stringpostdoc2027-g@vt.edu.
